pre_start_budget_correction.interpretation: Increase finite ceilings before first new-profile run using public loop structure and measured read overhead. Per-intent limits do not promise every intent exhausts its limit. Actual observed prior instance already had 9 accepted intents and 21 missing, so it is not described as 240 required sends. No worst-case completion guarantee is made.
pre_start_budget_correction.public_lower_bound: Conditional policy branch, not the observed 9-accepted instance: if a fresh instance has 30 public intents all requiring 8 attempts, then 4 fixed actions per attempt and at least 12 native calls per action imply at least 11520 calls for the send loop alone; other recovery work adds cost.

reporting_constraints_zh: 保留所有真实尝试及其失败材料，不把只读资格或语法检查计作完整B0。
工作流绿色可以只表示完整有效尝试；必须单列原始业务结果。
一次独立核验通过的B0成功即表明该实例存在集中式公开解法，不延迟承认这一点。
失败、未知、超预算或工程缺口均不能证明单智能体无法解决。
本轮没有多智能体速度优势或正式比赛合格结论；后续速度比较必须使用同一多智能体策略的串行与并行版本。

result_dimensions.additional_assurance: Historical terminal evidence and causal attribution to each send remain separate; missing history is unknown/not_evaluated, never fabricated as qualified.
result_dimensions.execution_integrity: All owned actions must be truly terminal and closed under the fixed profile before final reservation. The one accepted final action remains pending. Unknown execution is never waived.
result_dimensions.original_evaluation: Retain exact original bool or null from host evidence before reference cleanup; never replace it with self-check or acceptance acknowledgement.
result_dimensions.public_business_snapshot: pass, known_fail or incomplete; preserve accepted, missing, duplicate, wrong-recipient, issue, service and queue facts without defaulting absent evidence to pass.
